app_type: corporate marketing website (5 pages: Home, Solutions, Network, About Us, Contact)

brand_identity.positioning: Indonesian Enterprise Network Infrastructure & B2B Connectivity Partner
forbidden: Do not style like a cheap residential ISP
Do not invent fake specs or fake customer stats
No generic transparent sticky headers without blur background

color_palette.theme_type: Lighter Corporate (Crisp White/Slate with Deep Navy Structure and High-Energy Indonesian Tech Orange)

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none
scale.eyebrow_label: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-orange-600 font-bold

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: 1px orange glow borders on featured active network cards
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border border-slate-200/80 shadow-sm for header and floating cards
visual_enhancers.grid_borders: Subtle 1px border grid pattern (#E2E8F0) with exposed node points for technical aesthetic
visual_enhancers.motion_style: Framer Motion staggered line-by-line reveal, smooth momentum scroll via Lenis, interactive topology canvas with pulsing data packets

Home: Kinetic Hero: Animated interactive network visualization (Internet → Upstream Providers → Cergis Core Network → Fiber → Enterprise Customer → Branch/Office/Cloud) with real-time speed/ping simulation widget
Company Highlights & Metrics: 99.99% SLA Uptime Guarantee, Multi-Gigabit Metro Ethernet, Tier-3 Data Center Interconnects, 24/7/365 Local NOC Support
6 Core Solution Cards Grid: (1) Internet Service & IP Core, (2) Network Infrastructure, (3) SD-WAN, (4) Managed Services, (5) VoIP Enterprise, (6) VPS & Private Cloud
Why Cergis Matrix: Highlighting Flexibility, Redundancy, Local Expertise, and SLA Guarantees
Dark Signature Brand Section: 'Service is a Promise' featuring glowing fiber line animations and manifesto points
Final High-Impact CTA Banner: 'Elevate Your Corporate Connectivity'
Solutions: Detailed Breakdown for all 6 core services (Overview, Key Features, Architectural Benefits, Enterprise Use Cases)
Bandwidth & Capacity Configurator / Solution Request Modal
Network: Interactive Conceptual Architecture Diagram: Interactive node graph with clickable layers (Upstream Providers, Cergis Core, Redundant Routing, Fiber Backbone, Enterprise Customers)
Live Network Status & NOC Telemetry Dashboard simulation (Latency metrics, POP locations, Fiber route redundancy)
NOC Operations Spotlight: 24/7 Monitoring, Proactive Incident Mitigation, Field Engineering Readiness
About Us: Corporate Story: Powering Indonesia's Enterprise Economy
Interactive Timeline / Milestone Map: Cergis Infrastructure Evolution
'Our Approach' Values Grid: Customer-Centricity, Technical Rigor, Uncompromised Reliability, Future-Proof Flexibility
Contact: Enterprise Inquiry Form: Name, Company Name, Business Email, Phone, Industry, Required Service, Number of Locations, Detailed Message
Interactive Map / Office Locations (Jakarta HQ & Data Center Hubs)
Direct NOC Hotline & Technical Support escalation path

component_guidelines.Navbar: Sticky top bar with glassmorphism backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200. Clear logo, 5 page links, data-testid attributes, and glowing orange CTA button 'Talk to Our Team'.
component_guidelines.NetworkHeroVisualization: Canvas/SVG interactive topology graph with glowing pulses moving through node clusters. Hover reveals latency, bandwidth status, and routing paths.
component_guidelines.SolutionCards: Clean white cards with hover translate-y-1 elevation, orange subtle border glow, custom vector/Lucide icons, and concise enterprise feature lists.
component_guidelines.NetworkDiagram: Step-by-step interactive pipeline card display with node filters (Core, Upstream, Fiber, Enterprise Edge, Cloud Peering).
component_guidelines.ContactForm: Full enterprise contact inquiry form with controlled inputs, field validation, interactive status alerts (sonner toast on submit), and clear data-testid tags.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, nav items, form inputs, buttons, filter tabs, and section toggles MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-link-solutions', data-testid='contact-submit-button').
testing_and_accessibility.accessibility_rule: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 text contrast. Primary CTAs must have dark or white high-contrast text. Interactive hover states must explicitly specify both background and text colors.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling across all 5 pages.
Use Framer Motion for scroll reveals, staggered card entrances, and node pulse effects.
Ensure the sticky header does not obscure section content by using top padding pt-24 on main wrapper.
Implement Sonner toast notifications for all interactive actions like sending a contact message or requesting a quote.
Ensure full responsiveness across desktop, tablet, and mobile views with mobile hamburger drawer navigation.

Follow the exact user mandate: Light corporate palette (White/Slate background, Deep Navy text & structure, Indonesian Tech Orange accents) with a high-contrast dark signature 'Service is a Promise' section.
